name: The Bridge Wraith
description: the Warden of the Rune Bridges, a tall hooded wraith with no legs, her robe trailing off into pale mist, a deep hood with only two small pale-blue eyes inside it, long thin grey hands holding up a lantern made of glowing cyan runes with little shutters, soft cyan rune light on her robe's folds, anxious and polite posture

poses.stand: floating upright with the rune lantern held up in one hand, the shutters half open, her other hand clasped to her chest, hood tilted a little as if worried

dormant.action: folded down into a still grey hooded shape resting on the bridge, hood bowed, lantern dark and held against her chest

unwritten.action: the lantern held out wide with all its shutters flung open and blazing white-cyan, runes streaming off her robe like unravelling script, hood thrown back a little, eyes wide

dead.action: gone: only the rune lantern left standing alone on the bridge, set down, its shutters open and calm and glowing a soft steady cyan

idle.action: drifts and bobs gently in the air, robe mist swaying, the lantern's runes pulsing slowly

rise.action: unfolds upward off the bridge, lantern lighting rune by rune, mist curling off her robe

lantern.action: raises the lantern and opens its shutters wide, a ripple of cyan runes running out from it to the right, then lowers it with a small apologetic bow

hurt.action: is struck and flinches, the lantern's shutter flicking shut, a few runes scattering off her robe

enrage.action: flings the lantern's shutters open and her robe starts to unravel into streams of glowing script, trembling

idleEnraged.action: trembles in the air with the lantern held wide, runes streaming off her robe and fading, quick pulses of white-cyan light

die.action: stops trembling, sighs, sets the lantern down on the bridge and fades away into mist and drifting runes, leaving only the calm lantern
